mapper.select: SELECT NVL(POINT_BALANCE, 0) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

SELECT NVL(SUM(POINT_AMOUNT), 0) FROM TB_POINT WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND POINT_TYPE = 'EARN' AND ( REG_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM') || '%' -- 2026-07-29 형식 OR REG_DATE LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'RR/MM') || '%' -- 26/07/29 형식 )

SELECT POINT_ID AS pointId,
CASE WHEN REG_DATE LIKE '__/__/__' THEN '20' || SUBSTR(REG_DATE,1,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(REG_DATE,4,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(REG_DATE,7,2) ELSE REG_DATE END AS regDate, CASE REASON_CD WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN '리뷰 작성 적립' WHEN 'PURCHASE_CONFIRM' THEN '구매확정 적립' WHEN 'ORDER_CANCEL' THEN '주문 취소 환급' WHEN 'ORDER_USE' THEN '주문 시 포인트 사용' ELSE REASON_CD END AS content, POINT_TYPE AS pointType, POINT_AMOUNT AS pointAmount FROM TB_POINT WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY POINT_ID DESC
